input.title: Household organization and budget structures in a Purepecha pueblo
input.abstract: In Cuanajo, Michoacan, Mexico, where the local furniture industry has undergone substantial expansion, households vary widely in size, financial practices, and levels of economic success. Households use three different kinds of funds: General, Personal, and Obligated Funds. Each has different characteristics. Households of different sizes and levels of business success use different kinds of funds, which are combined in different ways. In this article I argue that these different ways of structuring budgets contribute to or detract from business success by influencing transaction costs within households.

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
